::: {#exr-jellyfish-open-socks}

```{mermaid}
graph LR
  X(X)
  Y(Y)
  Z(Z)
  U(U)
  V(V)
  W(W)

  X --> W
  Z --> W
  W --> U
  Y --> U
  U --> V
  Y --> V

  
{{< include ../mermaid-classes.txt >}}

class X exogenous
class Y exogenous
class Z exogenous
```

1. Which quantities are *exogenous*?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_jos.1.ekf
- 'X Y Z':
    correct: true
- 'U V W':
    correct: false
- 'X W U V':
    correct: false
- 'V':
    correct: false
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Q <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "jos-1-ekf",
  question = "Placeholder for now",
  answers = choices_jos.1.ekf,
  multiple = FALSE
)
Q(inline = TRUE)
```

For the endogenous quantities, each of the round-cornered, shaded boxes is a function. The *output* of the function is the quantity named in the box. The inputs to the function are the names of the quantities that are connected to the box by incoming arrows.

2. What are the inputs to the function V()?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_jos.2.hgw
- 'U':
    correct: false
- 'W & U & Y':
    correct: false
- 'U & Y':
    correct: true
- 'none. V is exogenous':
    correct: false
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Q <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "jos-2-hgw",
  question = "Placeholder for now",
  answers = choices_jos.2.hgw,
  multiple = FALSE
)
Q(inline = TRUE)
```

3. What are the inputs to the function W()?

```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_jos.3.s4w
- 'U':
    correct: false
- 'X only':
    correct: false
- 'X & Z':
    correct: true
- 'none. W is exogenous':
    correct: false
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Q <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "jos-3-s4w",

  multiple = FALSE
)

```

4. `r devoirs3::devoirs_TF(TRUE, label="jos-4-dw")` Is this collection of functions consistent with the system diagram?
    i. U(W, Y)
    ii. V(U, Y)
    iii. W(X, Z)

5. Consider a new system consisting of these functions and their inputs.
    i. B(A, E)
    ii. D(B, F)
    iii. F(B)
    iv. C(F, A)
    
Which are the exogenous quantities?
    
```{devoirs_choices}
#| label: choices_jos.5.was
- 'C & A':
    correct: false
- 'B & F':
    correct: false
- 'A & E':
    correct: true
- 'C & F':
    correct: false
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
Q <- devoirs_selection(
  label = "jos-5-was",
  question = "Placeholder for now",
  answers = choices_jos.5.was,
  multiple = FALSE
)
Q(inline = FALSE)
```
